messages.subject: Mitaine sur measure?
messages.text:
Bonjour,

J’ai un fils, agé 40, qui a cherché toute sa vie pour des mitaines sur mésure. Sa main droite est normale, mais l ne peut pas porter des mitaines normales sur sa main gauche. Il a 2 pouces et 2 droits.

C’est très frustrant can il est très actif dehors en hiver. Pourriez-vous nous aider? Merci!

Bien à vous,

Barbara Lewis

Ste. Agathe-des-Monts

(514)773-6846

messages.subject: Custom mitten request
messages.text:
Hi,
 

 I wrote to you several months ago on this subject but received no response. I really hope you can help me, but if not, please at least reply & let me know.

 

 So, to remind you, I have an adult son with a unique left hard. The right hand is fine, but the left has only 2 fingers and also 2 thumbs. No gloves or mittens work for him. He is
 outdoorsy and active and this has always been a frustration and a limitation for him. We have tried to find someone who could make him a mitten, but with no luck (except knitted mitts). If you are able to produce a left hand mitten that works, I would happily
 buy multiple pairs from you.

 

 Sorry about the poor sketch, but you get the idea….

 

 I’d be SO grateful for your help. Thank you for at least considering my request.

 

 Best wishes,

 Barbara Lewis

 Ste. Agathe des Monts

 
 (514)773-6846

messages.subject: Re: Mitaine sur measure?
messages.text:
Hi Barbara,

No problem at all, and thank you for following up.

To take measurements for a custom mitten, here's what would help us most:

1. The total length of the hand, from the base of the wrist to the tip of the longest finger
2. The width of the hand at its widest point (across the knuckles)
3. For each thumb: the length from base to tip, and the circumference at the base
4. For the two fingers: same thing, length and circumference at the base
5. A photo of the hand laid flat on a sheet of paper, with a ruler beside it, would be a big help too

Once your son is back and we have those, we'll look at the best way to approach the design and see what we can put together for him.

Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com
